customers.label: Customers
customers.definition: Customers (individual consumers and SMEs) by country as stated in Nu Holdings' 2024 Form 20-F; published rounded to the nearest 0.1 million ('101.8 million', 'surpassing 10 million', '2.5 million') and stored as people.

source.label: Nu Holdings 2024 Form 20-F, Item 4 business overview
source.quote: As of December 31, 2024, we had 114.2 million customers. In Brazil we had 101.8 million customers, which represented approximately 58% of the country’s population aged 18 and above. [101.8 million = 101,800,000]

source.label: Nu Holdings 2024 Form 20-F, Item 4 business overview
source.quote: In Mexico, our growth momentum continued, with our customer base surpassing 10 million. [10 million = 10,000,000]

source.label: Nu Holdings 2024 Form 20-F, Item 4 business overview
source.quote: Meanwhile, in Colombia our customer base expanded to 2.5 million customers, continuing its positive momentum following the launch of the Nu Cuenta product. [2.5 million = 2,500,000]

notes: Customers by country are stated in the FY2024 Form 20-F text (total 114.2 million, nearly 95 million active). Mexico is 'surpassing 10 million', recorded as 10,000,000 with plus. The 20-F gives employees only by function (8,716 total), not by country; it says all employees were based in offices in Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, Uruguay and the United States. Sites are from the offices table in Item 4.D (Querétaro coworking and Montevideo offices omitted as minor). The Durham office is listed as 'Durham, USA' with no state, so no state code is set. No U.S. state data.
